abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To investigate the CT and MRI features of pancreatic colloid carcinoma (PCC) and to correlate imaging findings with histopathological characteristics.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: The CT and MRI images and clinical data of 15 patients with PCC confirmed by surgical resection and histopathological examination from August 2009 to October 2023 were retrospectively analyzed.
RESULTS: All 15 PCC lesions presented as single masses, occurring in 8 males and 7 females (mean age 66 ± 8.4 years). The majority of lesions (73%) were located in the pancreatic head (11 cases), with 2 cases in the body, 1 in the tail, and 1 involving both body and tail. PCC typically manifested as cystic-solid masses with internal septations and calcification (8 cases, 53.3%). Associated findings included pancreatic ductal dilatation (13 cases), pancreatic atrophy (13 cases), and biliary dilatation (12 cases). On dynamic contrast-enhanced imaging, lesions demonstrated mild enhancement in the arterial phase and progressive sponge-like or reticular enhancement in the delayed phase. Compared with the surrounding parenchyma, the degree of enhancement in the arterial phase and portal venous phase was significantly lower (8.2 ± 6.7 vs. 19.3 ± 13.6, 9.67 ± 8.93 vs. 28.3 ± 17.2 HU, respectively; P < 0.05). The apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) values showed no significant difference between PCC lesions and surrounding parenchyma (2.248 ± 0.454 × 10⁻³ mm²/s vs. 1.829 ± 0.514 × 10⁻³ mm²/s; P > 0.05). Pathologically, all tumors were characterized by neoplastic epithelium suspended in extracellular mucin pools comprising more than 80% of the tumor volume, meeting current WHO diagnostic criteria for PCC.
CONCLUSION: The combination of imaging features in PCC-including presentation as a cystic or cystic-solid mass with progressive delayed sponge-like or reticular enhancement, a salt-and-pepper appearance on T2-weighted images, and frequent calcification-may facilitate its differentiation from other pancreatic cystic neoplasms when considered together. Progressive delayed reticular enhancement reflects fibrous stroma segregating the mucin pools, as confirmed by histopathological correlation.
key_points_ko: 총 15명의 환자(남성 8명, 여성 7명, 평균 연령 66세)의 췌장 점액성 암종 데이터를 분석했습니다.
종양은 주로 내부 격막과 석회화(8례, 53.3%)를 동반한 낭성-고형 종괴로 나타났습니다.
동맥기 및 문맥기 조영증강 정도는 주변 실질에 비해 유의하게 낮았습니다(P < 0.05).
summary_ko: 본 연구는 수술 및 조직병리 검사로 확진된 15명의 췌장 점액성 암종(pancreatic colloid carcinoma, PCC) 환자를 대상으로 CT와 MRI 영상 소견을 조사하고 이를 조직병리학적 특성과 비교했습니다. 환자 15명 중 73%에 해당하는 11건이 췌장 두부에 발생했으며, 종병은 주로 내부 격막과 석회화를 동반한 낭성-고형 종괴로 나타났습니다. 동적 조영증강 영상에서 병변은 동맥기에서 경미한 조영증강을 보였고 지연기에서는 점진적인 해면상 또는 망상 조영증강을 보였습니다. 조직학적으로 모든 종상은 80% 이상의 종양 부위를 차지하는 세포외 점액 풀 내에 신생물 상피가 현탁되어 있는 특징을 보였습니다.
title: Comparative analysis of the CT and MRI features of pancreatic colloid carcinoma
title_ko: 췌장 점액성 암종의 CT 및 MRI 영상 소견에 대한 비교 분석
